name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Spaghetti Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti casserole with ground beef, canned tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion in a frying pan.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour canned tomatoes over the spaghetti layer.
Spoon the browned meat mixture over the tomatoes.
Cover with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered, until cheese starts to get bubbly.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti casserole, ground beef, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.description: A hearty potato casserole made with frozen hash browns, cream soups, and grated cheese.

Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: potato casserole, hash browns, creamy, cheesy

_similar.name: Ham & Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A layered ham, potato, and cheese casserole cooked in a slow cooker.
recipeIngredient: Cream of mushroom or celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Put half of the ham, potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker.
Add the remaining half of the ingredients for the second layer.
Top with soup and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook on slow for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken
